system.description:
Weaving together a grand amount of mana, you send it soaring at a target. Make an Attack Roll at a creature within Range. On a hit, the targeted creature takes damage equal to Arcana + 3.

Elemental Spark Effects:

  • Fire: Your blast takes the form of a roaring flame. You deal additional damage equal to [2 x Arcana] and the target begins Burning on a failed Magykal Resist.
  • Water: Your blast takes the form of a deluge of water. The target is pushed back 3 Spaces and is Soaked on a failed Magykal Resist.
  • Earth: Your blast takes the form of a heaving stone. You deal additional damage equal to Arcana and enemies are Trapped under a pile of rubble on a failed Physical Resist. A creature can escape being Trapped in this way on a successful Strength check against your Magykal Potency.
  • Air: Your blast takes the form of a howling gale. You don't need Line of Sight to target a creature within range with this attack and the target is Dropped on a failed Physical Resist.
